description: This file contains implementation of TLS-related functions for websockets, including certificate validation, buffering, and accept management, specific to a linux-based libwebsockets project.

methods.name: int lws_tls_fake_POLLIN_for_buffered(struct lws_context_per_thread * pt)
methods.description: Fakes POLLIN events for TLS bufferred socket instances with buffered receive data, indicating data is ready to read.

methods.name: void __lws_ssl_remove_wsi_from_buffered_list(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Removes a websocket instance from the TLS buffered list.

methods.name: void lws_ssl_remove_wsi_from_buffered_list(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Locks the thread, then removes a websocket instance from the TLS buffered list.

methods.name: int lws_tls_check_cert_lifetime(struct lws_vhost * v)
methods.description: Checks the validity and expiry of the TLS certificate for a virtual host, logs expiry info, and broadcasts aging info.

methods.name: int lws_tls_check_all_cert_lifetimes(struct lws_context * context)
methods.description: Iterates over all virtual hosts and checks their certificate lifetimes.

methods.name: enum:lws_tls_extant lws_tls_generic_cert_checks(struct lws_vhost * vhost,const char * cert,const char * private_key)
methods.description: Verifies the presence and usability of certificate and private key files for a virtual host.

methods.name: int lws_tls_cert_updated(struct lws_context * context,const char * certpath,const char * keypath,const char * mem_cert,size_t len_mem_cert,const char * mem_privkey,size_t len_mem_privkey)
methods.description: Updates the certificate for each virtual host that uses the specified cert and key paths.

methods.name: int lws_gate_accepts(struct lws_context * context,int on)
methods.description: Enables or disables accepting new TLS connections and updates the poll events accordingly.

methods.name: int lws_alpn_comma_to_openssl(const char * comma,uint8_t * os,int len)
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated ALPN list into the OpenSSL format used in SSL contexts.
